thing-type.label: ATAG ONE Thermostat
thing-type.description: ATAG ONE smart thermostat — auto-discovered via UDP broadcast or configured manually.

channel-type.label: Room Temperature
channel-type.description: Room temperature as measured by the ATAG One thermostat's built-in sensor.

channel-type.label: Target Temperature
channel-type.description: Room temperature setpoint for the active preset.

channel-type.label: Outside Temperature (boiler estimate)
channel-type.description: Outside temperature as estimated by the ATAG One boiler. May show a stale value when the heating season is inactive. For reliable year-round outdoor readings use an independent sensor.

channel-type.label: Heating Circuit Temperature
channel-type.description: Current water temperature in the central heating circuit (Heizwasser). Reads ambient temperature when the boiler is idle.

channel-type.label: Heating Circuit Return Temperature
channel-type.description: Temperature of water returning from the heating circuit back to the boiler.

channel-type.label: CH Water Pressure
channel-type.description: Central heating circuit water pressure.

channel-type.label: Boiler Target Water Temperature
channel-type.description: Target water temperature the boiler is currently trying to reach for the heating circuit. Reads 0 °C when no heating demand is active.

channel-type.label: Hot Water Temperature
channel-type.description: Current temperature of the domestic hot water supply (tap and shower water).

channel-type.label: Hot Water Target Temperature
channel-type.description: Active domestic hot water temperature setpoint (tap and shower water).

channel-type.label: HVAC Mode
channel-type.description: Heating control mode — heat (normal) or auto (schedule-following).

channel-type.label: Preset Mode
channel-type.description: Active heating preset. Write auto to cancel any timed preset. Write holiday to activate vacation (set vacation-duration first). Manual is read-only — it is set by the device when you adjust the temperature on the display.

channel-type.label: Preset Mode Duration
channel-type.description: Remaining duration of the active timed preset (extend, vacation, or fireplace). UNDEF in manual or auto mode.

channel-type.label: DHW Mode
channel-type.description: Domestic hot water operating mode (raw device value).

channel-type.label: Flame
channel-type.description: Flame sensor — ON when the burner is firing.

channel-type.label: Burner Target
channel-type.description: What the burner is currently heating — ch (central heating), dhw, or none.

channel-type.label: Modulation Level
channel-type.description: Burner modulation level.

channel-type.label: Burning Hours
channel-type.description: Total boiler burner run hours.

channel-type.label: Time to Target
channel-type.description: Estimated time until the room reaches the target temperature.

channel-type.label: Vacation Duration
channel-type.description: Holiday duration in days. Writing this value activates holiday mode starting now.

channel-type.label: Vacation Start
channel-type.description: When the current holiday period started.

channel-type.label: Vacation End
channel-type.description: When the current holiday period ends.

channel-type.label: Vacation Temperature
channel-type.description: Temperature setpoint for vacation mode. Reads the active setpoint when vacation is running; reads the stored default otherwise. Writing while in vacation mode changes the active setpoint immediately.

channel-type.label: Extend Duration
channel-type.description: Stored default extend duration. Extend mode activates automatically when target-temperature is written while the device is in auto mode; this channel reflects the configured default duration.

channel-type.label: Fireplace Duration
channel-type.description: Reads the device's stored default fireplace duration. Writing activates fireplace mode for exactly the written duration and updates the stored default for future activations via preset-mode. Cancel by writing auto to preset-mode.

channel-type.label: Weather Status
channel-type.description: Current weather condition reported by the thermostat.

channel-type.label: Device Errors
channel-type.description: Active thermostat error codes (comma-separated, empty when none).

channel-type.label: Boiler Errors
channel-type.description: Active boiler error codes (comma-separated, empty when none).

channel-type.label: Displayed Setpoint
channel-type.description: Temperature setpoint shown on the thermostat display.

channel-type.label: Average Outside Temperature
channel-type.description: Weighted average outside temperature used by the regulation algorithm.

channel-type.label: PCB Temperature
channel-type.description: Thermostat circuit board temperature.

channel-type.label: WiFi Signal
channel-type.description: WiFi signal strength (negative — closer to 0 is stronger).

channel-type.label: Supply Voltage
channel-type.description: Thermostat supply voltage.

channel-type.label: Supply Current (raw)
channel-type.description: Thermostat supply current in device-internal units; the physical unit is not documented by the manufacturer.

channel-type.label: Gas Consumption Counter (raw)
channel-type.description: Raw device counter believed to relate to gas consumption; the scaling factor and physical unit are not confirmed against a live device and are therefore not applied.

channel-type.label: DHW Flow Rate
channel-type.description: Domestic hot water flow rate.

channel-type.label: Controller Resets
channel-type.description: Number of thermostat controller resets.

channel-type.label: Memory Allocation
channel-type.description: Thermostat memory allocation indicator (firmware-internal).

channel-type.label: Boiler Flow Temperature
channel-type.description: Boiler flow temperature (from OpenTherm or boiler bus).

channel-type.label: Boiler Return Temperature
channel-type.description: Boiler return water temperature (from OpenTherm or boiler bus).

channel-type.label: Minimum Modulation Level
channel-type.description: Minimum burner modulation level.

channel-type.label: Maximum Boiler Temperature
channel-type.description: Maximum boiler temperature limit.

channel-type.label: Vacation Remaining
channel-type.description: Remaining vacation duration (seconds).

channel-type.label: Extend Remaining
channel-type.description: Remaining extend mode duration (seconds).

channel-type.label: Fireplace Remaining
channel-type.description: Remaining fireplace mode duration (seconds).

channel-type.label: Report Time
channel-type.description: Timestamp of the last data report from the thermostat.
